family_reports.body: I wasn't ever given scheduled visitation with my son after a divorce. Family court said it was at the mother discretion. So when I would drive 3 hours to visit my ex-wife would make me pay her on top of the already court ordered child support or force me to stay at her home the entire time I was in town and sleep with her. I made the court aware even offered text and voice recordings. Nothing was done and I eventually had to quit going to visit as there was always a conflict but the court still wouldn't set scheduled visitation.
Made me and my child unsafe, distressed my household, stole precious bonding time with my child, gave me and my child mental health problems.
